id: \bPokémon know how to use berries. That means if you let them hold onto them they will use it in battle without your command.
en: \bPokémon know how to use berries. That means if you let them hold onto them they will use it in battle without your command.
it: \bI Pokémon sanno come usare le bacche. Quindi, se gliele fai tenere, le useranno in lotta senza che tu glielo ordini.
